title: PaperScope AI Deep Reading Result v1.6
description: Structured output contract for Scholar AI / PaperScope Deep Reading v1.6: triage, reconstruct, verify, critique, transfer; evidence inventory; source-grounded research judgment; guided return-to-source reading.

user_research_context.description: Optional user project/problem context. If supplied, use it to judge relevance and transfer value; never invent user context.

paper_type.description: Primary/secondary analytical lens. Classify by argument and evidence structure rather than discipline label.

evidence_coverage.description: Task-level coverage summary. Use coverage_matrix for component-level detail.

snippet.description: Short verbatim source excerpt only. Never model-generated.

paraphrase.description: Model summary of the source, never presented as original text.

verification_status.description: Verification of source excerpt/locator, not scientific replication.

supported_claim_ids.description: Backlinks to claims this evidence directly or indirectly supports. Empty is allowed for context-only evidence.

evidence_statement.description: reported = paper-explicit; inferred = grounded analysis; unknown = genuine non-establishment only.

why_needed.description: Why the method or claim depends on this assumption.

stress_test.description: Concrete experiment or analysis that could probe whether this assumption holds.

analyzed_version_label.description: Human-readable version actually analyzed, e.g. uploaded arXiv PDF v2 or publisher PDF.

support_reason.description: Explain why the linked paper-internal evidence supports the claim at this level; distinguish direct experiment support from author interpretation.

what_would_strengthen_it.description: Concrete analysis-derived validation or stress test. Never use placeholders such as current materials do not specify.

claim_title.description: Short user-facing title for the claim, e.g. Core method change or miniImageNet performance. Avoid raw IDs as the visible title.

core_weaknesses.description: Top 2-4 PaperScope analysis-derived core weaknesses. Prefer mechanism-level weaknesses over generic missing-experiment complaints.

open_question_item.description: Actionable unresolved question: question + why it matters + a concrete validation path. Do not generate filler questions to reach a fixed count.

why_read.description: Why this paper is worth the reader’s time; state the specific intellectual or methodological value rather than a generic score.

next_research_direction.description: Most promising bounded follow-up direction, without inventing a named architecture.

research_directions.description: Bounded follow-up directions derived from weaknesses/open questions. Do not generate named architectures or full proposals.

knowledge_takeaways.description: Optional sidecar for future knowledge-base workflows. Do not render as a seventh main report section by default.

note.description: Short explanation of how this evidence relates to the claim.

research_gap.description: Reconstruct the actual gap: author problem → author-claimed gap → analysis-derived bottleneck → bounded gap assessment.

minutes.description: Approximate minutes for this stop. Standard path should total roughly 15–25 minutes.

description.description: PaperScope analysis-derived weakness. It must not be written as if explicitly acknowledged by the authors unless separately recorded in author_acknowledged_limitations.

suggested_validation.description: Concrete stress test or analysis that could test the weakness.

core_weakness_item.description: Top 2–4 consequential, falsifiable weaknesses. Prefer mechanism/assumption/evaluation weaknesses over generic complaints.

target_problem.description: The unresolved problem or mechanism that a follow-up study should investigate.

rationale.description: Why this direction follows from the paper evidence, assumptions, or weaknesses.

validation_focus.description: What a follow-up study should measure or test. Stop at validation focus rather than inventing a named architecture.

boundary_note.description: Explicitly state that this is an analysis-derived direction, not an author-stated proposal, unless the paper says so.

research_direction_item.description: Bounded transfer direction derived from evidence/weaknesses. Stop at target problem, rationale and validation focus; do not invent a named model.

paper_lens.description: One primary analytical lens and at most one secondary lens for genuinely hybrid papers.

critical_artifacts.description: Human-readable main tables/figures/equations/sections that carry the paper argument.

missing_critical_evidence.description: Critical evidence that could not be inspected or verified.

evidence_inventory.description: Compact pre-analysis inventory. Build this before interpretation so the report is claim-grounded rather than summary-first.
